## DB Connection

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

Here, we start with connecting to the database.

```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)
library(tidyverse)

# set your working directory to the current file directory 
tryCatch({
  setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path))
  }, error=function(cond){message(paste("cannot change working directory"))
})

# Repository-relative location for the published data artifacts.
data_dir <- file.path("..", "data")

# Connection settings are read from local environment variables; never commit credentials.
augur_db_password <- Sys.getenv("AUGUR_DB_PASSWORD")
if (!nzchar(augur_db_password)) {
  stop("Set AUGUR_DB_PASSWORD in your local environment before rendering this notebook.")
}

# Adjust these to match your Docker Postgres configuration.
con <- dbConnect(
  RPostgres::Postgres(),
  host = Sys.getenv("AUGUR_DB_HOST", "localhost"),
  port = as.integer(Sys.getenv("AUGUR_DB_PORT", "5432")),
  dbname = Sys.getenv("AUGUR_DB_NAME", "augur"),
  user = Sys.getenv("AUGUR_DB_USER", "augur"),
  password = augur_db_password
)

# Basic identity & context
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT current_database() AS db, current_user AS usr,
                        inet_server_addr()::text AS host, inet_server_port() AS port;")


dbGetQuery(con, "SHOW search_path;")

# What schemas exist?
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT schema_name FROM information_schema.schemata ORDER BY 1;")

# Where is the repo table actually located?
dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT table_schema, table_name
  FROM information_schema.tables
  WHERE table_name IN ('repo','repo_groups')
  ORDER BY 1,2;
")

```

```{r}

dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS repos FROM augur_data.repo;")
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS commits FROM augur_data.commits;")
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS issues FROM augur_data.issues;")
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS messages FROM augur_data.message;")

```

## List current collection status

```{r}

current_db_status <- dbGetQuery(con, " WITH cs AS (
  SELECT r.repo_id, r.repo_git,
         cs.core_status, cs.secondary_status, cs.facade_status,
         cs.core_data_last_collected, cs.secondary_data_last_collected, cs.facade_data_last_collected
  FROM augur_data.repo r
  LEFT JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = r.repo_id
)
SELECT repo_id, repo_git, core_status, secondary_status, facade_status,
       core_data_last_collected, secondary_data_last_collected, facade_data_last_collected
FROM cs
ORDER BY COALESCE(GREATEST(
  COALESCE(core_data_last_collected,'epoch'::timestamp),
  COALESCE(secondary_data_last_collected,'epoch'::timestamp),
  COALESCE(facade_data_last_collected,'epoch'::timestamp)
),'epoch'::timestamp) DESC
LIMIT 200;
")
current_db_status

```

```{r}

# Query to get current worker activity and status
query <- "
SELECT
    worker,
    COUNT(*) AS active_tasks,
    MAX(status) AS current_status
FROM
    augur_operations.worker_history
GROUP BY
    worker
ORDER BY
    active_tasks DESC;
"

# Execute the query
worker_status <- dbGetQuery(con, query)

# Print the results
print(worker_status)

```

## GitHub authentication

GitHub credentials are intentionally not stored in this repository. Configure authentication directly in your local Augur/Docker deployment before collection.

```{r}

# Check overall collection status
overall_status <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT
  cs.secondary_status,
  cs.facade_status,
  COUNT(*) as num_repos
FROM augur_operations.collection_status cs
GROUP BY cs.secondary_status, cs.facade_status
ORDER BY num_repos DESC;
")

print(overall_status)

# Check specifically the repos from your batch
batch_repos <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT
  r.repo_git,
  cs.secondary_status,
  cs.facade_status,
  cs.secondary_data_last_collected,
  cs.facade_data_last_collected
FROM augur_data.repo r
JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON r.repo_id = cs.repo_id
WHERE r.repo_git IN (
  'https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd',
  'https://github.com/containerd/containerd',
  'https://github.com/artifacthub/hub',
  'https://github.com/v6d-io/v6d'
)
ORDER BY r.repo_git;
")

print(batch_repos)

```

# Read Parquet File for important repos

```{r}
library(arrow)

st_scores <- read_parquet(file.path(data_dir, "cncf_sociotechnical_scores.parquet"))

```

Let's create an aggregate ST score column, aggregate the repos by average aggregate ST score, and create bins of high vs low ST scores.

- File shows 3 ways to quantify socio-technical dependencies

- Want to understand temporal dependencies, e.g., if a score in one month is predictive of something else

```{r}

library(dplyr)

# add column of sum of ST score
st_scores <- st_scores %>% 
  mutate(st_sum = rowSums(select(.,st1_supplier_coverage,st2_developer_coverage,st3_edge_density)))


# group by cncf_repo_name and calculate average st_scores
st_scores_aggregated <- st_scores %>% 
  group_by(cncf_repo_name) %>% 
  summarize(mean_st_score = mean(st_sum, na.rm = T))

# create histogram of st_scores
library(ggplot2)

st_sum_histogram <- ggplot(st_scores_aggregated, aes(x=mean_st_score)) + 
  geom_histogram()

st_sum_histogram
```

Now, create a bin of the top 20 and bottom 20 percent:

```{r}
repos_least_st_score <- st_scores_aggregated %>%
  slice_min(order_by = mean_st_score, prop = 0.20)

repos_highest_st_score <- st_scores_aggregated %>%
  slice_max(order_by = mean_st_score, prop = 0.20)

```

# Analyses

Here, we start calculating some of the core sustainability and health metrics. We do this only for repositories that have a Success status for Core, Secondary, and Facade.

## Configuration: Filter by Repository Groups

Set the repository groups you want to analyze. Leave empty to analyze all repos.

```{r}
# Define which repo_group_ids to include in the analysis
# Examples: 
#   selected_repo_groups <- c(100, 200, 300)  # Specific groups
#   selected_repo_groups <- c()                # All groups (no filter)

selected_repo_groups <- c(100, 200, 300)  # Change this to filter by specific repo groups

# Create SQL filter string
if (length(selected_repo_groups) > 0) {
  repo_groups_sql <- paste(selected_repo_groups, collapse = ", ")
  cat("Analyzing repo groups:", repo_groups_sql, "\n")
} else {
  repo_groups_sql <- NULL
  cat("Analyzing all repo groups\n")
}
```

This is the current list that we're interested in: Issues: time to first response time to close closure ratio Window is 60 days (for example, September 2025 â†’ Look at all the issues opened in August and July, and identify the percentage that are still open from that set at the end of September.) num of issues

PRs: time to first response time to close closure ratio Window is 60 days (for example, September 2025 â†’ Look at all the PRs opened in August and July, and identify the percentage that are still open from that set at the end of September.) num of PRs

Community/contributors: num of contributors To be a contributor, you have to make 4 contributions Number of people contributing anything to a project in a given month. Num of new contributors If a person has contributed in the last two years, they are not a new contributor

Knowledge production: num of commits

## Configuration: Collection Status Requirements

Configure which collection statuses are required for different metric types.

**Data Collection Phases:** - **Core**: Basic repo info, issues, PRs (augur_data.issues, augur_data.pull_requests) - **Secondary**: Messages, events, detailed metadata (augur_data.message, augur_data.issue_events, augur_data.pull_request_events) - **Facade**: Commit data (augur_data.commits)

**Note**: To apply these filters to queries, replace the old hardcoded WHERE clauses:

```         
WHERE cs.core_status = 'Success'
  AND cs.secondary_status = 'Success'
  AND cs.facade_status = 'Success'
```

with the dynamic filter:

```         
WHERE ", collection_filters$<metric_type>, "
```

where `<metric_type>` is one of: issues, prs, contributors, commits

```{r}
# ====================
# COLLECTION STATUS CONFIGURATION
# ====================
# Set which collection phases must be 'Success' for each metric type
# TRUE = require Success, FALSE = include repos even if status is not Success
#
# Data Sources:
# - Core: issues, pull_requests, issue_labels, pr_labels, issue_assignees, etc.
# - Secondary: messages (comments), issue_events, pull_request_events, pr_reviews, pr_files, pr_commits
# - Facade: commits (from git clone)
#
# Metric Requirements:
# - Time to close: Core only (closed_at timestamp is in issues/PRs tables)
# - Closure ratio: Core only (state/closed_at in issues/PRs tables)
# - Number of issues/PRs: Core only
# - Time to first response: Core + Secondary (needs messages/events for response time)
# - Contributors (from issues/PRs/comments): Core + Secondary
# - Contributors (including commits): Core + Secondary + Facade
# - Commits: Facade only

config_collection_requirements <- list(
  # Issues/PRs basic metrics (count, time to close, closure ratio) - Core only
  issues_basic = list(core = TRUE, secondary = FALSE, facade = FALSE),
  prs_basic = list(core = TRUE, secondary = FALSE, facade = FALSE),
  
  # Issues/PRs response metrics (time to first response) - Core + Secondary
  issues_response = list(core = TRUE, secondary = TRUE, facade = FALSE),
  prs_response = list(core = TRUE, secondary = TRUE, facade = FALSE),
  
  # Contributors from issues/PRs/comments only - Core only (no secondary needed)
  contributors_core = list(core = TRUE, secondary = FALSE, facade = FALSE),
  
  # Contributors from issues/PRs/comments with secondary data - Core + Secondary
  contributors_no_commits = list(core = TRUE, secondary = TRUE, facade = FALSE),
  
  # Contributors including commits - Core + Secondary + Facade
  contributors_with_commits = list(core = TRUE, secondary = TRUE, facade = TRUE),
  
  # Commits metrics - Facade only
  commits = list(core = FALSE, secondary = FALSE, facade = TRUE),
  
  # Legacy aliases for backward compatibility
  issues = list(core = TRUE, secondary = TRUE, facade = FALSE),
  prs = list(core = TRUE, secondary = TRUE, facade = FALSE),
  contributors = list(core = TRUE, secondary = TRUE, facade = TRUE),
  
  # All three (for reference/backward compatibility)
  all_success = list(core = TRUE, secondary = TRUE, facade = TRUE)
)

# Display configuration
cat("\n=== Collection Status Requirements ===\n")
for (metric_type in names(config_collection_requirements)) {
  req <- config_collection_requirements[[metric_type]]
  cat(sprintf("%s: Core=%s, Secondary=%s, Facade=%s\n", 
              metric_type, req$core, req$secondary, req$facade))
}
```

## Create Repository Filter Lists

Generate SQL filter conditions for each metric type based on collection requirements:

```{r}
# Function to build collection status filter
build_status_filter <- function(requirements) {
  filters <- c()
  if (requirements$core) filters <- c(filters, "cs.core_status = 'Success'")
  if (requirements$secondary) filters <- c(filters, "cs.secondary_status = 'Success'")
  if (requirements$facade) filters <- c(filters, "cs.facade_status = 'Success'")
  
  if (length(filters) == 0) {
    return("1=1")  # No requirements, include all
  } else {
    return(paste(filters, collapse = "\n    AND "))
  }
}

# Create filter strings for each metric type
collection_filters <- list()
for (metric_type in names(config_collection_requirements)) {
  collection_filters[[metric_type]] <- build_status_filter(config_collection_requirements[[metric_type]])
}

# Display the SQL filters
cat("\n=== Generated SQL Filters ===\n")
for (metric_type in names(collection_filters)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n%s:\n  %s\n", metric_type, collection_filters[[metric_type]]))
}
```

## Retrieve Repository Lists by Collection Status

Get lists of repositories for each metric type:

```{r}
# Function to get repos with specific collection requirements
get_repos_by_status <- function(status_filter, repo_group_filter = NULL, label = "") {
  query <- paste0("
    SELECT r.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
           cs.core_status, cs.secondary_status, cs.facade_status
    FROM augur_data.repo r
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = r.repo_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
    WHERE ", status_filter,
    if (!is.null(repo_group_filter)) paste0("\n      AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_group_filter, ")") else "",
    "\n    ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git;"
  )
  
  repos <- dbGetQuery(con, query)
  cat(sprintf("%s: %d repositories\n", label, nrow(repos)))
  return(repos)
}

# Get repository lists for each metric type
repos_by_metric <- list()

cat("\n=== Repository Counts by Metric Type ===\n")
for (metric_type in names(config_collection_requirements)) {
  repos_by_metric[[metric_type]] <- get_repos_by_status(
    collection_filters[[metric_type]], 
    repo_groups_sql,
    label = metric_type
  )
}

# Create a summary comparison
cat("\n=== Summary ===\n")
cat(sprintf("All success (Core+Secondary+Facade): %d repos\n", nrow(repos_by_metric$all_success)))
cat(sprintf("Issues metrics (Core+Secondary): %d repos\n", nrow(repos_by_metric$issues)))
cat(sprintf("PRs metrics (Core+Secondary): %d repos\n", nrow(repos_by_metric$prs)))
cat(sprintf("Contributors metrics (Core+Secondary+Facade): %d repos\n", nrow(repos_by_metric$contributors)))
cat(sprintf("Commits metrics (Facade only): %d repos\n", nrow(repos_by_metric$commits)))

# Keep backward compatibility - successful_repos is same as all_success
successful_repos <- repos_by_metric$all_success
successful_repos
```

## Issues Metrics

### Time to First Response (Issues) - Monthly Summary

This calculates comprehensive statistics (min, Q1, median, Q3, max, mean) for time (in hours) from issue creation to the first comment or event, calculated within each month:

```{r}
query_issues_first_response <- paste0("
  WITH first_response AS (
    SELECT 
      i.repo_id,
      i.issue_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', i.created_at)::date as month,
      i.created_at as issue_created,
      i.reporter_id as issue_creator_id,
      LEAST(
        COALESCE(MIN(m.msg_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE m.msg_timestamp > i.created_at AND m.cntrb_id != i.reporter_id), '9999-12-31'::timestamp),
        COALESCE(MIN(ie.created_at) FILTER (WHERE ie.created_at > i.created_at AND ie.cntrb_id != i.reporter_id), '9999-12-31'::timestamp)
      ) as first_response_time
    FROM augur_data.issues i
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = i.repo_id
    INNER JOIN augur_data.repo r ON i.repo_id = r.repo_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.issue_message_ref imr ON i.issue_id = imr.issue_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.message m ON imr.msg_id = m.msg_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.issue_events ie ON i.issue_id = ie.issue_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$issues_response, "
      AND i.pull_request IS NULL",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n      AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
    GROUP BY i.repo_id, i.issue_id, i.created_at, i.reporter_id
  )
    SELECT 
      r.repo_id,
      r.repo_git,
      r.repo_name,
      r.repo_group_id,
      rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
      fr.month,
      COUNT(fr.issue_id) AS total_issues,
      COUNT(fr.issue_id) FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31'::timestamp) AS issues_with_response,
      COUNT(fr.issue_id) FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time >= '9999-12-31'::timestamp) AS issues_no_response,
      ROUND(MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.issue_created)) / 3600) FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31')::numeric, 2) as min_hours,
      ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.issue_created)) / 3600) FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31')::numeric, 2) as q1_hours,
      ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.issue_created)) / 3600) FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31')::numeric, 2) as median_hours,
      ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.issue_created)) / 3600) FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31')::numeric, 2) as q3_hours,
      ROUND(MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.issue_created)) / 3600) FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31')::numeric, 2) as max_hours,
      ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.issue_created)) / 3600) FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31')::numeric, 2) as mean_hours
    FROM first_response fr
    JOIN augur_data.repo r ON fr.repo_id = r.repo_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
    GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, fr.month
    ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, fr.month DESC;
  ")

issues_time_to_first_response_summary <- dbGetQuery(con, query_issues_first_response)
issues_time_to_first_response_summary
```

### Time to First Response (Issues) - Raw Data

Individual issue-level data for detailed analysis and visualization:

```{r}
query_issues_first_response_raw <- paste0("
  WITH first_response AS (
    SELECT 
      i.repo_id,
      i.issue_id,
      i.gh_issue_number,
      i.created_at as issue_created,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', i.created_at)::date as month,
      i.reporter_id as issue_creator_id,
      LEAST(
        COALESCE(MIN(m.msg_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE m.msg_timestamp > i.created_at AND m.cntrb_id != i.reporter_id), '9999-12-31'::timestamp),
        COALESCE(MIN(ie.created_at) FILTER (WHERE ie.created_at > i.created_at AND ie.cntrb_id != i.reporter_id), '9999-12-31'::timestamp)
      ) as first_response_time
    FROM augur_data.issues i
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = i.repo_id
    INNER JOIN augur_data.repo r ON i.repo_id = r.repo_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.issue_message_ref imr ON i.issue_id = imr.issue_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.message m ON imr.msg_id = m.msg_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.issue_events ie ON i.issue_id = ie.issue_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$issues_response, "
      AND i.pull_request IS NULL",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n      AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
    GROUP BY i.repo_id, i.issue_id, i.gh_issue_number, i.created_at, i.reporter_id
  )
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    fr.month,
    fr.issue_id,
    fr.gh_issue_number,
    fr.issue_created,
    fr.first_response_time,
    ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.issue_created)) / 3600::numeric, 2) as hours_to_first_response
  FROM first_response fr
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON fr.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
  WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31'::timestamp
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, fr.month DESC, fr.issue_created;
")

issues_time_to_first_response_raw <- dbGetQuery(con, query_issues_first_response_raw)
issues_time_to_first_response_raw
```

### Time to Close (Issues) - Monthly Summary

This only requires Core data (closed_at timestamp is in the issues table).

```{r}
query_issues_close <- paste0("
  SELECT 
    i.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', i.created_at)::date as month,
    COUNT(i.issue_id) as closed_issues,
    ROUND(MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.closed_at - i.created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as min_hours,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.closed_at - i.created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as q1_hours,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.closed_at - i.created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as median_hours,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.closed_at - i.created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as q3_hours,
    ROUND(MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.closed_at - i.created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as max_hours,
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.closed_at - i.created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as mean_hours
  FROM augur_data.issues i
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON i.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
  INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = i.repo_id
  WHERE ", collection_filters$issues_basic, "
    AND i.pull_request IS NULL
    AND i.closed_at IS NOT NULL",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n    AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  GROUP BY i.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', i.created_at)
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, month DESC;
")

issues_time_to_close_summary <- dbGetQuery(con, query_issues_close)
issues_time_to_close_summary
```

### Time to Close (Issues) - Raw Data

This only requires Core data.

```{r}
query_issues_close_raw <- paste0("
  SELECT 
    i.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,

  WHERE ", collection_filters$issues_basic, "
    AND i.pull_request IS NULL
    AND i.closed_at IS NOT NULL",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n    AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, month DESC, i.created_at;
")

issues_time_to_close_raw <- dbGetQuery(con, query_issues_close_raw)
issues_time_to_close_raw
```

### Closure Ratio with 60-Day Window (Issues)

For each month, this looks at issues opened in the previous 60 days and calculates what percentage are still open. This only requires Core data (issue state and timestamps).

```{r}
query_issues_closure <- paste0("
  WITH monthly_periods AS (
    SELECT 
      DATE_TRUNC('month', d)::date as month_end,
      (DATE_TRUNC('month', d) - INTERVAL '60 days')::date as window_start,
      (DATE_TRUNC('month', d) - INTERVAL '1 day')::date as window_end
    FROM generate_series(
      (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM augur_data.issues) + INTERVAL '60 days',
      CURRENT_DATE,
      '1 month'::interval
    ) d
  ),
  issue_status AS (
    SELECT 
      i.repo_id,
      r.repo_git,
      r.repo_name,
      r.repo_group_id,
      rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
      mp.month_end,
      i.issue_id,
      i.created_at,
      i.closed_at,
      CASE 
        WHEN i.closed_at IS NULL OR i.closed_at > mp.month_end THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END as still_open
    FROM augur_data.issues i
    JOIN augur_data.repo r ON i.repo_id = r.repo_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = i.repo_id
    CROSS JOIN monthly_periods mp
    WHERE ", collection_filters$issues_basic, "
      AND i.pull_request IS NULL
      AND i.created_at::date BETWEEN mp.window_start AND mp.window_end",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n      AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  )
  SELECT 
    repo_id,
    repo_git,
    repo_name,
    repo_group_id,
    repo_group_name,
    month_end,
    COUNT(issue_id) as issues_in_window,
    SUM(still_open) as still_open,
    ROUND((SUM(still_open)::numeric / COUNT(issue_id) * 100), 2) as pct_still_open,
    ROUND(((COUNT(issue_id) - SUM(still_open))::numeric / COUNT(issue_id) * 100), 2) as closure_ratio_pct
  FROM issue_status
  GROUP BY repo_id, repo_git, repo_name, repo_group_id, repo_group_name, month_end
  HAVING COUNT(issue_id) > 0
  ORDER BY repo_group_name, repo_git, month_end DESC;
")

issues_closure_ratio <- dbGetQuery(con, query_issues_closure)
issues_closure_ratio
```

### Closure Ratio (Issues) - Summary by Repository

This aggregates the monthly closure ratios by repository and provides a 6-point summary. Core data only.

```{r}
query_issues_closure_summary <- paste0("
  WITH monthly_periods AS (
    SELECT 
      DATE_TRUNC('month', d)::date as month_end,
      (DATE_TRUNC('month', d) - INTERVAL '60 days')::date as window_start,
      (DATE_TRUNC('month', d) - INTERVAL '1 day')::date as window_end
    FROM generate_series(
      (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM augur_data.issues) + INTERVAL '60 days',
      CURRENT_DATE,
      '1 month'::interval
    ) d
  ),
  issue_status AS (
    SELECT 
      i.repo_id,
      r.repo_git,
      r.repo_name,
      r.repo_group_id,
      rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
      mp.month_end,
      i.issue_id,
      i.created_at,
      i.closed_at,
      CASE 
        WHEN i.closed_at IS NULL OR i.closed_at > mp.month_end THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END as still_open
    FROM augur_data.issues i
    JOIN augur_data.repo r ON i.repo_id = r.repo_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = i.repo_id
    CROSS JOIN monthly_periods mp
    WHERE ", collection_filters$issues_basic, "
      AND i.pull_request IS NULL
      AND i.created_at::date BETWEEN mp.window_start AND mp.window_end",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n      AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  ),
  monthly_closure_ratios AS (
    SELECT 
      repo_id,
      repo_git,
      repo_name,
      repo_group_id,
      repo_group_name,
      month_end,
      ROUND(((COUNT(issue_id) - SUM(still_open))::numeric / COUNT(issue_id) * 100), 2) as closure_ratio_pct
    FROM issue_status
    GROUP BY repo_id, repo_git, repo_name, repo_group_id, repo_group_name, month_end
    HAVING COUNT(issue_id) > 0
  )
  SELECT 
    repo_id,
    repo_git,
    repo_name,
    repo_group_id,
    repo_group_name,
    COUNT(month_end) as num_months,
    ROUND(MIN(closure_ratio_pct)::numeric, 2) as min_closure_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closure_ratio_pct)::numeric, 2) as q1_closure_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closure_ratio_pct)::numeric, 2) as median_closure_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closure_ratio_pct)::numeric, 2) as q3_closure_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(MAX(closure_ratio_pct)::numeric, 2) as max_closure_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(closure_ratio_pct)::numeric, 2) as mean_closure_ratio_pct
  FROM monthly_closure_ratios
  GROUP BY repo_id, repo_git, repo_name, repo_group_id, repo_group_name
  ORDER BY repo_group_name, repo_git;
")

issues_closure_ratio_summary <- dbGetQuery(con, query_issues_closure_summary)
issues_closure_ratio_summary
```

## PRs Metrics

### Time to First Response (PRs) - Monthly Summary

This requires Core + Secondary data (messages/events for first response detection).

```{r}
query_prs_first_response <- paste0("
  WITH first_response AS (
    SELECT 
      pr.repo_id,
      pr.pull_request_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.pr_created_at)::date as month,
      pr.pr_created_at as pr_created,
      pr.pr_augur_contributor_id as pr_creator_id,
      LEAST(
        COALESCE(MIN(m.msg_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE m.msg_timestamp > pr.pr_created_at AND m.cntrb_id != pr.pr_augur_contributor_id), '9999-12-31'::timestamp),
        COALESCE(MIN(pre.created_at) FILTER (WHERE pre.created_at > pr.pr_created_at AND pre.cntrb_id != pr.pr_augur_contributor_id), '9999-12-31'::timestamp)
      ) as first_response_time
    FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = pr.repo_id
    INNER JOIN augur_data.repo r ON pr.repo_id = r.repo_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.pull_request_message_ref pmr ON pr.pull_request_id = pmr.pull_request_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.message m ON pmr.msg_id = m.msg_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.pull_request_events pre ON pr.pull_request_id = pre.pull_request_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$prs_response, "",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n      AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
    GROUP BY pr.repo_id, pr.pull_request_id, pr.pr_created_at, pr.pr_augur_contributor_id
  )
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    fr.month,
    COUNT(fr.pull_request_id) AS total_prs,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31'::timestamp) AS prs_with_response,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time >= '9999-12-31'::timestamp) AS prs_no_response,
    ROUND(MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.pr_created)) / 3600) 
          FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31'::timestamp)::numeric, 2) as min_hours,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.pr_created)) / 3600)
          FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31'::timestamp)::numeric, 2) as q1_hours,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.pr_created)) / 3600)
          FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31'::timestamp)::numeric, 2) as median_hours,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.pr_created)) / 3600)
          FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31'::timestamp)::numeric, 2) as q3_hours,
    ROUND(MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.pr_created)) / 3600)
          FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31'::timestamp)::numeric, 2) as max_hours,
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.pr_created)) / 3600)
          FILTER (WHERE fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31'::timestamp)::numeric, 2) as mean_hours
  FROM first_response fr
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON fr.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, fr.month
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, fr.month DESC;
")

prs_time_to_first_response_summary <- dbGetQuery(con, query_prs_first_response)
prs_time_to_first_response_summary
```

### Time to First Response (PRs) - Raw Data

This requires Core + Secondary data.

```{r}
query_prs_first_response_raw <- paste0("
  WITH first_response AS (
    SELECT 
      pr.repo_id,
      pr.pull_request_id,
      pr.pr_src_number,
      pr.pr_created_at as pr_created,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.pr_created_at)::date as month,
      pr.pr_augur_contributor_id as pr_creator_id,
      LEAST(
        COALESCE(MIN(m.msg_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE m.msg_timestamp > pr.pr_created_at AND m.cntrb_id != pr.pr_augur_contributor_id), '9999-12-31'::timestamp),
        COALESCE(MIN(pre.created_at) FILTER (WHERE pre.created_at > pr.pr_created_at AND pre.cntrb_id != pr.pr_augur_contributor_id), '9999-12-31'::timestamp)
      ) as first_response_time
    FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = pr.repo_id
    INNER JOIN augur_data.repo r ON pr.repo_id = r.repo_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.pull_request_message_ref pmr ON pr.pull_request_id = pmr.pull_request_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.message m ON pmr.msg_id = m.msg_id
    LEFT JOIN augur_data.pull_request_events pre ON pr.pull_request_id = pre.pull_request_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$prs_response, "",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n      AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
    GROUP BY pr.repo_id, pr.pull_request_id, pr.pr_src_number, pr.pr_created_at, pr.pr_augur_contributor_id
  )
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    fr.month,
    fr.pull_request_id,
    fr.pr_src_number,
    fr.pr_created,
    fr.first_response_time,
    CASE 
      WHEN fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31'::timestamp 
        THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fr.first_response_time - fr.pr_created)) / 3600::numeric, 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END as hours_to_first_response,
    (fr.first_response_time < '9999-12-31'::timestamp) AS responded
  FROM first_response fr
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON fr.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
  WHERE 1=1
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, fr.month DESC, fr.pr_created;
")

prs_time_to_first_response_raw <- dbGetQuery(con, query_prs_first_response_raw)
prs_time_to_first_response_raw
```

### Time to Close (PRs) - Monthly Summary

This only requires Core data (pr_closed_at is in the pull_requests table).

```{r}
query_prs_time_to_close <- paste0("
  SELECT 
    pr.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.pr_created_at)::date as month,
    COUNT(pr.pull_request_id) as closed_prs,
    ROUND(MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.pr_closed_at - pr.pr_created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as min_hours,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.pr_closed_at - pr.pr_created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as q1_hours,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.pr_closed_at - pr.pr_created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as median_hours,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.pr_closed_at - pr.pr_created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as q3_hours,
    ROUND(MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.pr_closed_at - pr.pr_created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as max_hours,
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.pr_closed_at - pr.pr_created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as mean_hours
  FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON pr.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
  INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = pr.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$prs_basic, "
    AND pr.pr_closed_at IS NOT NULL",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n    AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  GROUP BY pr.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.pr_created_at)
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, month DESC;
")
```

### PR Acceptance Rate (Merged / Closed) - Monthly

```{r}
query_prs_acceptance <- paste0("
  WITH prs AS (
    SELECT
      pr.repo_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.pr_created_at)::date AS month,
      pr.pr_closed_at IS NOT NULL AS is_closed,
      pr.pr_merged_at IS NOT NULL AS is_merged
    FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = pr.repo_id
    INNER JOIN augur_data.repo r ON pr.repo_id = r.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$prs_basic, "",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n      AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  )
  SELECT
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name AS repo_group_name,
    prs.month,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_closed) AS closed_prs,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_closed AND is_merged) AS merged_prs,
    ROUND(
      CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_closed) = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_closed AND is_merged))::numeric
                / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_closed)
      END, 4
    ) AS acceptance_rate
  FROM prs
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON r.repo_id = prs.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, prs.month
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, prs.month DESC;
")

prs_acceptance_monthly <- dbGetQuery(con, query_prs_acceptance)
prs_acceptance_monthly
```

```{r}
      mp.month_end,
```

```{r}
    WHERE ", collection_filters$prs_basic, "",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n      AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
      AND pr.pr_created_at::date BETWEEN mp.window_start AND mp.window_end
  ),
  monthly_closure_ratios AS (
    SELECT 
      repo_id,
      repo_git,
      repo_name,
      repo_group_id,
      repo_group_name,
      month_end,
      ROUND(((COUNT(pull_request_id) - SUM(still_open))::numeric / COUNT(pull_request_id) * 100), 2) as closure_ratio_pct
    FROM pr_status
    GROUP BY repo_id, repo_git, repo_name, repo_group_id, repo_group_name, month_end
    HAVING COUNT(pull_request_id) > 0
  )
  SELECT 
    repo_id,
    repo_git,
    repo_name,
    repo_group_id,
    repo_group_name,
    COUNT(month_end) as num_months,
    ROUND(MIN(closure_ratio_pct)::numeric, 2) as min_closure_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closure_ratio_pct)::numeric, 2) as q1_closure_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closure_ratio_pct)::numeric, 2) as median_closure_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closure_ratio_pct)::numeric, 2) as q3_closure_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(MAX(closure_ratio_pct)::numeric, 2) as max_closure_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(closure_ratio_pct)::numeric, 2) as mean_closure_ratio_pct
  FROM monthly_closure_ratios
  GROUP BY repo_id, repo_git, repo_name, repo_group_id, repo_group_name
  ORDER BY repo_group_name, repo_git;
")

prs_closure_ratio_summary <- dbGetQuery(con, query_prs_closure_ratio_summary)
prs_closure_ratio_summary
```

## Community/Contributors Metrics

**PERFORMANCE NOTE:** These queries have been optimized for performance: 1. New contributors query uses pre-aggregated monthly activity instead of correlated subqueries 2. Team metrics query filters by collection_status to avoid processing failed repos 3. Contributor months uses GROUP BY instead of DISTINCT for better performance

**RECOMMENDED INDEXES:** Ensure the following indexes exist for optimal performance:

``` sql
-- For new contributors and activity tracking
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_issues_reporter_created ON augur_data.issues(reporter_id, created_at) WHERE pull_request IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_prs_contributor_created ON augur_data.pull_requests(pr_augur_contributor_id, pr_created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_message_cntrb_timestamp ON augur_data.message(cntrb_id, msg_timestamp);

-- For commits-based queries
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_commits_repo_date ON augur_data.commits(repo_id, cmt_committer_date);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_commits_author_date ON augur_data.commits(cmt_ght_author_id, cmt_author_timestamp) WHERE cmt_ght_author_id IS NOT NULL;

-- For collection status filtering
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_collection_status_facade ON augur_operations.collection_status(repo_id, facade_status);
```

### Number of Contributors (Monthly) - From Issues/PRs/Comments Only

This version counts contributors from Core+Secondary data only (no commits). Contributors are anyone who opened an issue, opened a PR, or left a comment.

```{r}
query_contributors_count_no_commits <- paste0("
  WITH all_contributions AS (
    -- Issues opened
    SELECT 
      i.repo_id,
      i.reporter_id as cntrb_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', i.created_at)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.issues i
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = i.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_no_commits, "
      AND i.pull_request IS NULL
      AND i.reporter_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- PRs opened
    SELECT 
      pr.repo_id,
      pr.pr_augur_contributor_id as cntrb_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.pr_created_at)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = pr.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_no_commits, "
      AND pr.pr_augur_contributor_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Issue comments
    SELECT 
      m.repo_id,
      m.cntrb_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', m.msg_timestamp)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.message m
    INNER JOIN augur_data.issue_message_ref imr ON m.msg_id = imr.msg_id
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = m.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_no_commits, "
      AND m.cntrb_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- PR comments
    SELECT 
      m.repo_id,
      m.cntrb_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', m.msg_timestamp)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.message m
    INNER JOIN augur_data.pull_request_message_ref pmr ON m.msg_id = pmr.msg_id
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = m.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_no_commits, "
      AND m.cntrb_id IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    ac.month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ac.cntrb_id) as num_contributors
  FROM all_contributions ac
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON ac.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n  WHERE r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, ac.month
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, ac.month DESC;
")

contributors_count_monthly <- dbGetQuery(con, query_contributors_count_no_commits)
contributors_count_monthly
```

### Core Contributors (4+ contributions per month)

Contributors who have made 4 or more contributions in a given month. Uses core data only (issues, PRs, comments) - no commit data needed.

```{r}
query_core_contributors <- paste0("
  WITH all_contributions AS (
    -- Issues opened
    SELECT 
      i.repo_id,
      i.reporter_id as cntrb_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', i.created_at)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.issues i
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = i.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
      AND i.pull_request IS NULL
      AND i.reporter_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- PRs opened
    SELECT 
      pr.repo_id,
      pr.pr_augur_contributor_id as cntrb_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.pr_created_at)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = pr.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
      AND pr.pr_augur_contributor_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Issue comments
    SELECT 
      m.repo_id,
      m.cntrb_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', m.msg_timestamp)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.message m
    INNER JOIN augur_data.issue_message_ref imr ON m.msg_id = imr.msg_id
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = m.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
      AND m.cntrb_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- PR comments
    SELECT 
      m.repo_id,
      m.cntrb_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', m.msg_timestamp)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.message m
    INNER JOIN augur_data.pull_request_message_ref pmr ON m.msg_id = pmr.msg_id
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = m.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
      AND m.cntrb_id IS NOT NULL
  ),
  contributor_counts AS (
    SELECT 
      repo_id,
      month,
      cntrb_id,
      COUNT(*) as num_contributions
    FROM all_contributions
    GROUP BY repo_id, month, cntrb_id
  )
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    cc.month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cc.cntrb_id) as num_core_contributors
  FROM contributor_counts cc
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON cc.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
  WHERE cc.num_contributions >= 4",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n    AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, cc.month
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, cc.month DESC;
")
```

### New Contributors (Monthly)

New contributors are those who haven't contributed to the project in the previous 2 years. Uses core data only (issues, PRs, comments) - no commit data needed.

```{r}
query_new_contributors <- paste0("
  WITH all_contributions AS (
    -- Issues opened
    SELECT 
      i.repo_id,
      i.reporter_id as cntrb_id,
      i.created_at as contribution_date
    FROM augur_data.issues i
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = i.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
      AND i.pull_request IS NULL
      AND i.reporter_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- PRs opened
    SELECT 
      pr.repo_id,
      pr.pr_augur_contributor_id as cntrb_id,
      pr.pr_created_at as contribution_date
    FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = pr.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
      AND pr.pr_augur_contributor_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Issue comments
    SELECT 
      m.repo_id,
      m.cntrb_id,
      m.msg_timestamp as contribution_date
    FROM augur_data.message m
    INNER JOIN augur_data.issue_message_ref imr ON m.msg_id = imr.msg_id
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = m.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
      AND m.cntrb_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- PR comments
    SELECT 
      m.repo_id,
      m.cntrb_id,
      m.msg_timestamp as contribution_date
    FROM augur_data.message m
    INNER JOIN augur_data.pull_request_message_ref pmr ON m.msg_id = pmr.msg_id
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = m.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
      AND m.cntrb_id IS NOT NULL
  ),
  -- OPTIMIZATION: Pre-calculate first contribution date and monthly activity
  first_contribution AS (
    SELECT 
      repo_id,
      cntrb_id,
      MIN(contribution_date) as first_contrib_date
    FROM all_contributions
    GROUP BY repo_id, cntrb_id
  ),
  contributor_months AS (
    SELECT 
      ac.repo_id,
      ac.cntrb_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', ac.contribution_date)::date as contrib_month,
      fc.first_contrib_date
    FROM all_contributions ac
    JOIN first_contribution fc ON ac.repo_id = fc.repo_id AND ac.cntrb_id = fc.cntrb_id
    GROUP BY ac.repo_id, ac.cntrb_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', ac.contribution_date)::date, fc.first_contrib_date
  ),
  -- OPTIMIZATION: Pre-calculate activity windows to avoid NOT EXISTS for each row
  prior_activity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      ac.repo_id,
      ac.cntrb_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', ac.contribution_date)::date as active_month
    FROM all_contributions ac
  ),
  new_in_month AS (
    SELECT 
      cm.repo_id,
      cm.cntrb_id,
      cm.contrib_month,
      CASE 
        -- First-ever contribution this month
        WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', cm.first_contrib_date)::date = cm.contrib_month THEN 1
        -- OR no activity in prior 2 years (using LEFT JOIN for better performance)
        WHEN pa.active_month IS NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END as is_new
    FROM contributor_months cm
    LEFT JOIN prior_activity pa ON 
      pa.repo_id = cm.repo_id 
      AND pa.cntrb_id = cm.cntrb_id 
      AND pa.active_month >= cm.contrib_month - INTERVAL '2 years'
      AND pa.active_month < cm.contrib_month
  )
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    nm.contrib_month as month,
    SUM(nm.is_new) as num_new_contributors
  FROM new_in_month nm
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON nm.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n  WHERE r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, nm.contrib_month
  HAVING SUM(nm.is_new) > 0
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, nm.contrib_month DESC;
")

new_contributors_monthly <- dbGetQuery(con, query_new_contributors)
new_contributors_monthly
```

### Cumulative Counts (Issues, PRs, Commits)

Calculate cumulative totals up to each month for issues, PRs, and commits.

```{r}
cat("Calculating cumulative counts for issues, PRs, and commits...\n")

# Cumulative Issues Count (all issues created up to and including each month)
query_cumulative_issues <- paste0("
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    months.month,
    COUNT(i.issue_id) as cumulative_issues_count
  FROM augur_data.repo r
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.issues
    WHERE created_at IS NOT NULL
  ) months
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.issues i ON r.repo_id = i.repo_id 
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', i.created_at)::date <= months.month
    AND i.pull_request IS NULL
  INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = r.repo_id
  WHERE ", collection_filters$issues_basic, "",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n    AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, months.month
  ORDER BY r.repo_git, months.month DESC;
")

cumulative_issues <- dbGetQuery(con, query_cumulative_issues)
cat("Retrieved", nrow(cumulative_issues), "repo-months with cumulative issue counts\n")

# Cumulative PRs Count (all PRs created up to and including each month)
query_cumulative_prs <- paste0("
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    months.month,
    COUNT(pr.pull_request_id) as cumulative_prs_count
  FROM augur_data.repo r
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', pr_created_at)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.pull_requests
    WHERE pr_created_at IS NOT NULL
  ) months
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.pull_requests pr ON r.repo_id = pr.repo_id 
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.pr_created_at)::date <= months.month
  INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = r.repo_id
  WHERE ", collection_filters$prs_basic, "",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n    AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, months.month
  ORDER BY r.repo_git, months.month DESC;
")

cumulative_prs <- dbGetQuery(con, query_cumulative_prs)
cat("Retrieved", nrow(cumulative_prs), "repo-months with cumulative PR counts\n")

# Cumulative Commits Count (all commits up to and including each month)
query_cumulative_commits <- paste0("
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    months.month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.cmt_commit_hash) as cumulative_commits_count
  FROM augur_data.repo r
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', cmt_author_timestamp)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.commits
    WHERE cmt_author_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  ) months
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.commits c ON r.repo_id = c.repo_id 
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', c.cmt_author_timestamp)::date <= months.month
  INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = r.repo_id
  WHERE ", collection_filters$commits, "",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n    AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, months.month
  ORDER BY r.repo_git, months.month DESC;
")

cumulative_commits_direct <- dbGetQuery(con, query_cumulative_commits)
cat("Retrieved", nrow(cumulative_commits_direct), "repo-months with cumulative commit counts\n")
```

## Comprehensive Monthly Metrics - All Variables

This section creates a comprehensive monthly dataset with all requested metrics per repo-month, including stars/forks from the augur_aux tables, new contributors, PR/issue counts, and velocity metrics.

### Stars and Forks (Monthly counts from augur_aux tables)

```{r}
# Monthly stars (new stars added each month)
query_stars_monthly <- "
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', ars.starred_at)::date as month,
    COUNT(*) as num_stars
  FROM augur_aux_repo_stars ars
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON ars.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
  WHERE ars.starred_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', ars.starred_at)
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, month DESC;
"

stars_monthly <- dbGetQuery(con, query_stars_monthly)
cat("Retrieved", nrow(stars_monthly), "repo-months with star data\n")

# Monthly forks (new forks created each month)
query_forks_monthly <- "
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', arf.fork_created_at)::date as month,
    COUNT(*) as num_forks
  FROM augur_aux_repo_forks arf
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON arf.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
  WHERE arf.fork_created_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', arf.fork_created_at)
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, month DESC;
"

forks_monthly <- dbGetQuery(con, query_forks_monthly)
cat("Retrieved", nrow(forks_monthly), "repo-months with fork data\n")

# Calculate cumulative stars and forks
stars_monthly <- stars_monthly %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(month)) %>%
  arrange(repo_git, month) %>%
  group_by(repo_git) %>%
  mutate(cumulative_stars = cumsum(replace_na(num_stars, 0))) %>%
  ungroup()

forks_monthly <- forks_monthly %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(month)) %>%
  arrange(repo_git, month) %>%
  group_by(repo_git) %>%
  mutate(cumulative_forks = cumsum(replace_na(num_forks, 0))) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Added cumulative star and fork counts\n")
```

### New PR Contributors (Monthly)

Contributors who opened their first PR (or first PR in 2+ years) in each month:

```{r}
query_new_pr_contributors <- paste0("
  WITH first_pr_per_contributor AS (
    SELECT 
      pr.repo_id,
      pr.pr_augur_contributor_id as cntrb_id,
      MIN(pr.pr_created_at) as first_pr_date
    FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = pr.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$prs_basic, "
      AND pr.pr_augur_contributor_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pr.repo_id, pr.pr_augur_contributor_id
  ),
  monthly_pr_contributors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      pr.repo_id,
      pr.pr_augur_contributor_id as cntrb_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.pr_created_at)::date as month,
      fp.first_pr_date
    FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = pr.repo_id
    JOIN first_pr_per_contributor fp ON pr.repo_id = fp.repo_id 
      AND pr.pr_augur_contributor_id = fp.cntrb_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$prs_basic, "
      AND pr.pr_augur_contributor_id IS NOT NULL
  ),
  new_in_month AS (
    SELECT 
      mp.repo_id,
      mp.cntrb_id,
      mp.month,
      CASE 
        WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', mp.first_pr_date)::date = mp.month THEN 1
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 
          FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr2 
          WHERE pr2.repo_id = mp.repo_id 
            AND pr2.pr_augur_contributor_id = mp.cntrb_id 
            AND pr2.pr_created_at >= mp.month - INTERVAL '2 years'
            AND pr2.pr_created_at < mp.month
        ) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END as is_new
    FROM monthly_pr_contributors mp
  )
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    nm.month,
    SUM(nm.is_new) as num_new_pr_contributors
  FROM new_in_month nm
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON nm.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n  WHERE r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, nm.month
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, nm.month DESC;
")

new_pr_contributors_monthly <- dbGetQuery(con, query_new_pr_contributors)
cat("Retrieved", nrow(new_pr_contributors_monthly), "repo-months with new PR contributor data\n")
```

### PR Open to Merge Time (Monthly median - project velocity metric)

```{r}
query_pr_open2merge_monthly <- paste0("
  SELECT 
    pr.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.pr_created_at)::date as month,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.pr_merged_at IS NOT NULL) as num_merged_prs,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.pr_merged_at - pr.pr_created_at)) / 3600)
          FILTER (WHERE pr.pr_merged_at IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 2) as median_pr_open2merge_hours
  FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON pr.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
  INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = pr.repo_id
  WHERE ", collection_filters$prs_basic, "",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n    AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  GROUP BY pr.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.pr_created_at)
  HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.pr_merged_at IS NOT NULL) > 0
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, month DESC;
")

pr_open2merge_monthly <- dbGetQuery(con, query_pr_open2merge_monthly)
cat("Retrieved", nrow(pr_open2merge_monthly), "repo-months with PR merge time data\n")
```

### Total Contributions Count (Monthly)

Count total contribution actions (issues opened + PRs opened + comments):

```{r}
query_contributions_monthly <- paste0("
  WITH all_contributions AS (
    -- Issues opened
    SELECT 
      i.repo_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', i.created_at)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.issues i
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = i.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
      AND i.pull_request IS NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- PRs opened
    SELECT 
      pr.repo_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.pr_created_at)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = pr.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Issue comments
    SELECT 
      m.repo_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', m.msg_timestamp)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.message m
    INNER JOIN augur_data.issue_message_ref imr ON m.msg_id = imr.msg_id
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = m.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- PR comments
    SELECT 
      m.repo_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', m.msg_timestamp)::date as month
    FROM augur_data.message m
    INNER JOIN augur_data.pull_request_message_ref pmr ON m.msg_id = pmr.msg_id
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = m.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
  )
  SELECT 
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    ac.month,
    COUNT(*) as num_contributions
  FROM all_contributions ac
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON ac.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n  WHERE r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, ac.month
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, ac.month DESC;
")
```

### Contributor Absence Factor (Bus Factor, Monthly)

Smallest number of contributors accounting for at least 50% of monthly contributions. We calculate this for the combined contribution stream and separately for issues, comments, and commits.

```{r}
build_bus_factor_query <- function(contribution_sql, collection_filter, metric_col) {
  paste0("
  WITH all_contributions AS (
", contribution_sql, "
  ),
  contributor_counts AS (
    SELECT
      repo_id,
      month,
      cntrb_id,
      COUNT(*) as num_contributions
    FROM all_contributions
    GROUP BY repo_id, month, cntrb_id
  ),
  ranked_contributors AS (
    SELECT
      repo_id,
      month,
      cntrb_id,
      num_contributions,
      SUM(num_contributions) OVER (
        PARTITION BY repo_id, month
      ) as total_contributions,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY repo_id, month
        ORDER BY num_contributions DESC, cntrb_id
      ) as contributor_rank,
      SUM(num_contributions) OVER (
        PARTITION BY repo_id, month
        ORDER BY num_contributions DESC, cntrb_id
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) as running_contributions
    FROM contributor_counts
  )
  SELECT
    r.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    rc.month,
    MIN(rc.contributor_rank) FILTER (
      WHERE rc.running_contributions >= 0.5 * rc.total_contributions
    ) as ", metric_col, "
  FROM ranked_contributors rc
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON rc.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id",
    if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n  WHERE r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
    "
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, rc.month
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, rc.month DESC;
")
}

bus_factor_core_contribution_sql <- paste0(
"    -- Issues opened
    SELECT
      i.repo_id,
      i.reporter_id as cntrb_id,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', i.created_at)::date as month

    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = i.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
      AND i.pull_request IS NULL
      AND i.reporter_id IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- PRs opened
    SELECT
      pr.repo_id,

    FROM augur_data.pull_requests pr

    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
      AND pr.pr_augur_contributor_id IS NOT NULL

    -- Issue comments

    INNER JOIN augur_data.issue_message_ref imr ON m.msg_id = imr.msg_id
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = m.repo_id
    WHERE ", collection_filters$contributors_core, "
      AND m.cntrb_id IS NOT NULL

    -- PR comments
    SELECT
      m.repo_id,

    INNER JOIN augur_data.pull_request_message_ref pmr ON m.msg_id = pmr.msg_id
    INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = m.repo_id

)
```

### Releases Count (Monthly)

Count number of releases published per month:

```{r}
query_releases_monthly <- paste0("
  SELECT 
    rel.repo_id,
    r.repo_git,
    r.repo_name,
    r.repo_group_id,
    rg.rg_name as repo_group_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', rel.release_published_at)::date as month,
    COUNT(*) as num_releases
  FROM augur_data.releases rel
  JOIN augur_data.repo r ON rel.repo_id = r.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.repo_groups rg ON r.repo_group_id = rg.repo_group_id
  INNER JOIN augur_operations.collection_status cs ON cs.repo_id = rel.repo_id
  WHERE cs.core_status = 'Success'
    AND rel.release_published_at IS NOT NULL",
  if (!is.null(repo_groups_sql)) paste0("\n    AND r.repo_group_id IN (", repo_groups_sql, ")") else "",
  "
  GROUP BY rel.repo_id, r.repo_git, r.repo_name, r.repo_group_id, rg.rg_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', rel.release_published_at)
  ORDER BY rg.rg_name, r.repo_git, month DESC;
")

releases_monthly <- dbGetQuery(con, query_releases_monthly)
cat("Retrieved", nrow(releases_monthly), "repo-months with release counts\n")
```

```{r}
    MIN(c.cmt_committer_date) as first_commit_date
  FROM augur_data.repo r
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.commits c ON r.repo_id = c.repo_id
  WHERE c.cmt_committer_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.repo_git;
"

repo_first_commits <- dbGetQuery(con, query_repo_first_commit)
cat("Retrieved first commit dates for", nrow(repo_first_commits), "repos\n")

# Note: Age will be calculated dynamically when joining with monthly data

# age_in_years = age_in_months / 12
```

## Create and Save Monthly Augur Metrics Dataset

This section consolidates all Augur monthly metrics into a single comprehensive dataset. This dataset can be used independently or merged with ST scores for predictive analysis.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("CREATING COMPREHENSIVE MONTHLY AUGUR METRICS DATASET\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")

# Start with a base of all repo-month combinations from repos we care about
# Get repos from specified groups
base_repos <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT DISTINCT
    repo_id,
    repo_git,
    repo_name,
    repo_group_id
  FROM augur_data.repo
  WHERE repo_group_id IN (100, 200, 300)
  ORDER BY repo_git;
")

cat("Base repositories:", nrow(base_repos), "\n")
cat("  - Group 100:", sum(base_repos$repo_group_id == 100), "\n")
cat("  - Group 200:", sum(base_repos$repo_group_id == 200), "\n")
cat("  - Group 300:", sum(base_repos$repo_group_id == 300), "\n\n")

# Create a vector of repo_gits to filter on
target_repos <- base_repos$repo_git
cat("Filtering metrics to", length(target_repos), "target repositories\n\n")

# Create comprehensive monthly dataset by merging all metrics
# We'll use a full outer join approach starting with the most complete metric
augur_monthly <- NULL

# Function to safely merge metrics
merge_metric <- function(base_df, new_df, metric_name, target_repos) {
  if (exists(metric_name) && nrow(get(metric_name)) > 0) {
    df <- get(metric_name) %>%
      mutate(month = as.Date(month)) %>%
      # Filter to only target repos BEFORE merging
      filter(repo_git %in% target_repos)
    
    # Remove redundant metadata columns that will be added later
    # Keep only repo_git, month, and actual metric columns
    metadata_cols <- c("repo_id", "repo_name", "repo_group_id", "repo_group_name", 
                       "rg_name", "rg_description", "tool_source", "tool_version", "data_source")
    df <- df %>%
      select(-any_of(metadata_cols))
    
    if (is.null(base_df)) {
      cat("  âœ“ Initialized with", metric_name, ":", nrow(df), "rows\n")
      return(df)
    } else {
      before_count <- nrow(base_df)
      base_df <- base_df %>%
        full_join(df, by = c("repo_git", "month"))
      after_count <- nrow(base_df)
      cat("  âœ“ Merged", metric_name, ": ", before_count, "â†’", after_count, "rows\n")
      return(base_df)
    }
  } else {
    cat("  âœ— Skipped", metric_name, "(not found or empty)\n")
    return(base_df)
  }
}

cat("Building comprehensive monthly dataset...\n\n")

# 1. Issues metrics

    rename_with(~paste0("issues_tfr_", .), .cols = c("min_hours", "q1_hours", "median_hours", "q3_hours", "max_hours", "mean_hours"))

}

augur_monthly <- merge_metric(augur_monthly, issues_time_to_first_response_summary, 
                               "issues_time_to_first_response_summary", target_repos)
augur_monthly <- merge_metric(augur_monthly, issues_time_to_close_summary,

for (col in count_cols) {

  }
}

# Add dynamic characteristics (age, cumulative metrics, dependencies)
cat("\n8. Calculating Dynamic Repository Characteristics:\n")

# Get first commit dates for age calculation
repo_ages <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT 
    r.repo_git,
    MIN(c.cmt_committer_date::timestamp) as first_commit_date
  FROM augur_data.repo r
  LEFT JOIN augur_data.commits c ON r.repo_id = c.repo_id
  WHERE r.repo_group_id IN (100, 200, 300)
  GROUP BY r.repo_git
")
repo_ages$first_commit_date <- as.Date(repo_ages$first_commit_date)

cat("  âœ“ Retrieved first commit dates for", nrow(repo_ages), "repos\n")

# Calculate age for each repo-month
augur_monthly <- augur_monthly %>%
  left_join(repo_ages, by = "repo_git") %>%
  mutate(
    repo_age_interval = interval(first_commit_date, month),
    repo_age_days     = pmax(0, as.numeric(repo_age_interval / days(1))),
    age_in_months     = pmax(0, round(time_length(repo_age_interval, "months"), 2)),
    repo_age_years    = pmax(0, round(time_length(repo_age_interval, "years"), 2)),
    age_in_years      = repo_age_years
  )
cat("  âœ“ Calculated repository age\n")

# Calculate cumulative metrics
augur_monthly <- augur_monthly %>%
  arrange(repo_git, month) %>%
  group_by(repo_git) %>%
  mutate(
    # Cumulative commits (if we have monthly commits)
    cumulative_commits = if("num_commits" %in% names(.)) {
      cumsum(replace_na(num_commits, 0))
    } else NA_real_,
    
    # Cumulative authors (approximate - sum of monthly contributors)
    cumulative_authors = if("num_contributors" %in% names(.)) {
      cumsum(replace_na(num_contributors, 0))
    } else NA_real_,
    
    # Cumulative releases
    cumulative_releases = if("num_releases" %in% names(.)) {
      cumsum(replace_na(num_releases, 0))
    } else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("  âœ“ Calculated cumulative metrics\n")

# Replace NAs with 0 for all num_* columns (count metrics)

augur_monthly <- augur_monthly %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(num_cols), ~replace_na(., 0)))
cat("  âœ“ Replaced NAs with 0 for", length(num_cols), "count columns\n")

# Add static repo attributes

repo_static <- dbGetQuery(con, "

    primary_language,
    repo_archived,
    description
  FROM augur_data.repo
  WHERE repo_group_id IN (100, 200, 300)
")

augur_monthly <- augur_monthly %>%
  left_join(repo_static, by = "repo_git")

cat("  âœ“ Added primary_language, repo_archived, description\n")

# Add dependency metrics (latest snapshot per month)
cat("\n10. Adding Dependency Metrics:\n")
dep_data <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT 
    r.repo_git,
    rd.data_collection_date::date as snapshot_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rd.dep_name) as total_dependencies,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rd.dep_language) as dependency_languages
  FROM augur_data.repo r
  JOIN augur_data.repo_dependencies rd ON r.repo_id = rd.repo_id
  WHERE r.repo_group_id IN (100, 200, 300)
    AND rd.data_collection_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.repo_git, rd.data_collection_date::date
")

if (nrow(dep_data) > 0) {
  dep_data$snapshot_date <- as.Date(dep_data$snapshot_date)
  
  # For each repo-month, find most recent dependency snapshot
  dep_monthly <- augur_monthly %>%
    select(repo_git, month) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    left_join(dep_data, by = "repo_git", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    filter(!is.na(snapshot_date)) %>%
    group_by(repo_git, month) %>%
    filter(snapshot_date <= month) %>%
    filter(snapshot_date == max(snapshot_date)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(repo_git, month, total_dependencies, dependency_languages)
  
  augur_monthly <- augur_monthly %>%
    left_join(dep_monthly, by = c("repo_git", "month"))
  
  cat("  âœ“ Added dependency metrics for", nrow(dep_monthly), "repo-months\n")
} else {
  cat("  âœ— No dependency data available\n")
}

# Final cleanup and organization

# Reorganize columns for better readability
id_cols <- c("repo_id", "repo_git", "repo_name", "repo_group_id", "month")
age_cols <- c("first_commit_date", "repo_age_days", "age_in_months", "repo_age_years", "age_in_years")

cat("  - Group 200:", sum(augur_monthly$repo_group_id == 200, na.rm = TRUE), "repo-months\n")
cat("  - Group 300:", sum(augur_monthly$repo_group_id == 300, na.rm = TRUE), "repo-months\n\n")
```

## Forward-Looking Analysis: ST Scores with 6-Month Ahead Metrics

This section creates a dataset that combines socio-technical scores from one month with repository metrics from 6 months later. This enables predictive modeling to understand if ST scores can predict future repository health.

**Note:** This now uses the `augur_monthly_metrics` dataset created above, merged with ST scores.

### Prepare ST Scores Data

First, ensure the st_scores data has proper date formatting and add a column for the target month (6 months ahead):

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)

cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("CREATING PREDICTIVE DATASET: ST SCORES â†’ 6-MONTH AHEAD METRICS\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")

# Prepare st_scores with proper date column and calculate 6-month-ahead date
st_scores_prepared <- st_scores %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert period (YYYYmm format) to Date
    # Example: 202101 -> 2021-01-01
    month = as.Date(paste0(period, "01"), format = "%Y%m%d"),
    
    # Calculate the target month (6 months ahead)
    target_month = month %m+% months(6),
    
    # Keep the ST score sum we created earlier
    st_sum = rowSums(select(., st1_supplier_coverage, st2_developer_coverage, st3_edge_density), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(cncf_repo_name, month, target_month, 
         st1_supplier_coverage, st2_developer_coverage, st3_edge_density, 
         technical_supplier_count, social_supplier_count, 
         social_event_count_sum_over_suppliers, social_user_count_sum_over_suppliers)

cat("Prepared ST scores:", nrow(st_scores_prepared), "rows\n")
cat("  - Date range:", format(min(st_scores_prepared$month)), "to", format(max(st_scores_prepared$month)), "\n")
cat("  - Target range:", format(min(st_scores_prepared$target_month)), "to", format(max(st_scores_prepared$target_month)), "\n\n")

# Create repository name mapping
# Get all repos from database for mapping
all_repos <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT 
    repo_id,
    repo_git,
    repo_name,
    repo_group_id
  FROM augur_data.repo r
  ORDER BY repo_git;
")

# Extract the last two parts of the repo_git URL to match st_scores format
# Example: "https://github.com/aeraki-mesh/aeraki" -> "aeraki-mesh/aeraki"
all_repos <- all_repos %>%
  mutate(
    repo_name_full = str_extract(repo_git, "[^/]+/[^/]+$")
  )

# Create a clean mapping table (one row per unique repo_name_full)
repo_mapping <- all_repos %>%
  dplyr::select(repo_git, repo_name_full, repo_id, repo_group_id) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(repo_name_full) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Repository mapping:\n")
cat("  - Unique repos in mapping:", n_distinct(repo_mapping$repo_name_full), "\n")
cat("  - Unique repos in st_scores:", n_distinct(st_scores_prepared$cncf_repo_name), "\n\n")

# Start building predictive dataset
# Join st_scores with repo mapping
predictive_dataset <- st_scores_prepared %>%
  left_join(repo_mapping, by = c("cncf_repo_name" = "repo_name_full"), relationship = "many-to-one")

# Report matching statistics
cat("Matching Results:\n")
cat("  - Total ST score rows:", nrow(predictive_dataset), "\n")
cat("  - Successfully matched:", sum(!is.na(predictive_dataset$repo_git)), "\n")
cat("  - Unmatched:", sum(is.na(predictive_dataset$repo_git)), "\n")

# Show unmatched repos if any
unmatched_repos <- predictive_dataset %>%
  filter(is.na(repo_git)) %>%
  distinct(cncf_repo_name) %>%
  pull(cncf_repo_name)

if (length(unmatched_repos) > 0) {
  cat("\n  Unmatched repos from st_scores:\n")
  print(head(unmatched_repos, 10))
}

# Filter to only matched rows and specified repo groups
predictive_dataset <- predictive_dataset %>%
  filter(!is.na(repo_git)) %>%
  filter(repo_group_id %in% c(100, 200, 300))

cat("\nAfter filtering to repo groups 100, 200, 300:", nrow(predictive_dataset), "rows\n\n")

# Now merge with augur_monthly TWICE:
# 1. For month t (same month as ST scores) - suffix "_t"
# 2. For month t+6 (6 months ahead) - suffix "_t_plus_6"
cat("Merging augur metrics for month t and month t+6...\n")

if (exists("augur_monthly") && nrow(augur_monthly) > 0) {
  # Ensure augur_monthly has date type
  augur_monthly <- augur_monthly %>%
    mutate(month = as.Date(month))
  
  # Prepare augur data (remove duplicate repo identifiers)
  augur_clean <- augur_monthly %>%
    select(-repo_id, -repo_name, -repo_group_id)
  
  # Join 1: Augur metrics from month t (same month as ST scores)
  cat("\n1. Merging month t metrics...\n")
  augur_t <- augur_clean %>%
    rename_with(~paste0(., "_t"), -c(repo_git, month))
  
  before_count <- nrow(predictive_dataset)
  predictive_dataset <- predictive_dataset %>%
    left_join(augur_t, 
              by = c("repo_git" = "repo_git", "month" = "month"))
  
  after_count <- nrow(predictive_dataset)
  cat("  âœ“ Merged month t metrics: ", before_count, "â†’", after_count, "rows\n")
  
  # Report matching success for month t
  metrics_matched_t <- sum(!is.na(predictive_dataset$age_in_months_t))
  cat("  âœ“ Rows with month t metrics:", metrics_matched_t, "/", nrow(predictive_dataset), 
      "(", round(100 * metrics_matched_t / nrow(predictive_dataset), 1), "%)\n")
  
  # Join 2: Augur metrics from month t+6 (6 months ahead)
  cat("\n2. Merging month t+6 metrics...\n")
  augur_t_plus_6 <- augur_clean %>%
    rename_with(~paste0(., "_t_plus_6"), -c(repo_git, month))
  
  before_count <- nrow(predictive_dataset)
  predictive_dataset <- predictive_dataset %>%
    left_join(augur_t_plus_6, 
              by = c("repo_git" = "repo_git", "target_month" = "month"))
  
  after_count <- nrow(predictive_dataset)
  cat("  âœ“ Merged month t+6 metrics: ", before_count, "â†’", after_count, "rows\n")
  
  # Report matching success for month t+6
  metrics_matched_t_plus_6 <- sum(!is.na(predictive_dataset$age_in_months_t_plus_6))
  cat("  âœ“ Rows with month t+6 metrics:", metrics_matched_t_plus_6, "/", nrow(predictive_dataset), 
      "(", round(100 * metrics_matched_t_plus_6 / nrow(predictive_dataset), 1), "%)\n")
  
} else {
  cat("  âœ— ERROR: augur_monthly dataset not found!\n")
  cat("    Please run the 'Create and Save Monthly Augur Metrics Dataset' section first.\n")
}

cat("\n\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("PREDICTIVE DATASET CREATED\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")

# Display the result
cat("Predictive dataset dimensions:", nrow(predictive_dataset), "rows x", ncol(predictive_dataset), "columns\n")
head(predictive_dataset, 10)
```

### Summary Statistics of the Predictive Dataset

```{r}
# Show structure
library(tidyverse)
str(predictive_dataset)

# Summary statistics
cat("\n=== Dataset Overview ===\n")
cat("Number of unique repositories:", n_distinct(predictive_dataset$repo_git), "\n")
cat("Date range:", format(min(predictive_dataset$month, na.rm = TRUE)), "to", format(max(predictive_dataset$month, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
cat("Target date range (6 months ahead):", format(min(predictive_dataset$target_month, na.rm = TRUE)), "to", format(max(predictive_dataset$target_month, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")

# Check for missing data
cat("\n=== Missing Data Summary ===\n")
missing_summary <- predictive_dataset %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "missing_count") %>%
  mutate(missing_pct = round(missing_count / nrow(predictive_dataset) * 100, 2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_count))

print(missing_summary, n = 50)
```
